title: mexico city contract and procurement opportunities - u.s. embassy & consulates in mexico
paragraphs: small, medium and large companies: for those of you who are responsible offerors, with permits and licenses to do business in mexico and interested in offering your services, supplies and/or goods/items to the u.s. embassy in mexico, please submit your ueid (see requirements), name, title, company name, complete address, telephone number, cell phone number, email address and a brief description of the services, supplies and/or goods/items your company is offering.  also, if available, please provide a link to your company’s website. send this information to the email address indicated on the advertisements, pointing out which type of product or service your company would like to offer. requirements: interested companies must obtain their ncage/cage code and unique entity identification ( ueid ). for all actions in excess of $30,000, offerors must also have an active registration in the system for award management before submitting their quote. go to sam entity registration to obtain your ueid and start your registration process. international o fferors need their ncage code ( ncage code request tool ) before registering in sam. u.s. companies will obtain a cage code when requesting their ueid for the first time.

rfq number: rfq fy26-0002. peace corps – request for quotation for new vehicle peace corps mexico has a need for 1 vehicle.  peace corps is soliciting fixed-price quotations from the vendor community for the vehicle detailed below. if you are interested in submitting a quotation, please do so by sending your completed and signed attachment 1—vendor quotation form by email to: rlopez@peacecorps.gov quotations are due no later than 6 pm cst utc-6 on august 28 th , 2026. late quotations will not be accepted. please click on the link for more information: request for quotation new vehicle pcmx final event production services – 19mx5326q0025 please note this solicitation is not ready to be issued as of this date. the u.s. embassy in mexico city will launch the solicitation on sam.gov when it is available. the u.s. embassy in mexico city requires a professional event production company to design, build, equip, staff, and manage its booth space in a trade show in mexico city. the contractor will be responsible for comprehensive booth services including design and infrastructure, utilities, kitchen equipment, promotional materials, audiovisual services, photography and videography, staffing, security, and daily operational support throughout the event. the anticipated performance period will begin upon contract award for planning and coordination activities, with on-site execution from june 7 through july 5, 2026. all responsible sources may submit a quotation, which will be considered as long as it complies with the rfq requirements. interested companies should
